sections.name: Records of Ancient Matters & Divine Liturgies

chapters.name: The Age of the Gods (Kamiyo)
chapters.subtitle: The harmony of heaven, earth, and kami

verses.text: The names of the Deities that were born in the Plain of High Heaven when the Heaven and Earth began were: the Deity Master-of-the-August-Center-of-Heaven, next the High-August-Producing-Wondrous Deity, next the Divine-Producing-Wondrous Deity.
verses.original: 天地初發之時、於高天原成神名、天之御中主神、次高御產巢日神、次神產巢日神。
verses.transliteration: Ame-tsuchi no hajime no toki, Takama-no-hara ni nareru kami no na...

verses.text: Live with a heart as bright and upright as the sun (Akaki kiyoki kokoro). Cultivate gratitude towards all beings and revere the divine spirit in nature.
verses.original: 明き清き心をもて、天地の神々に仕え奉るべし。
verses.transliteration: Akaki kiyoki kokoro o mote, ame-tsuchi no kamigami ni...
